name: replace a vector by the index of its nearest codebook entry
mechanism: hold a codebook of representative vectors, replace each input vector by the index of its nearest entry, and let the decoder look the entry up; the codebook is learned from data

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Vector quantization' in section Information theory and signal processing / Coding theory / Lossy compression algorithms: technique often used in lossy data compression

fails_when: codebook size versus distortion is the whole trade
